summary: ObjectGenome validates caster swivelAxis and rollAxis independently as unit vectors but never validates their relationship. Equal or antiparallel unit axes therefore remain canonical, collapsing semantically distinct swivel and wheel-roll motions onto one degree of freedom. The gap also survives retained generation-8 PR #395's standalone decoder preflight, which independently calls isCanonicalUnitAxis() for each axis.
evidence: Current src/shared/Objects/ObjectGenome.luau caster validation requires positive finite wheelRadiusM plus unit swivelAxis and rollAxis, with no dot/cross/collinearity or independent-DOF predicate.

Retained PR #395 exact head ebfd17e7a2d5cf2083b90e0122b70bc5c39d0962 adds standaloneMechanismIsCanonical(), but caster acceptance still checks isCanonicalUnitAxis(swivelAxis) and isCanonicalUnitAxis(rollAxis) independently.
The canonical office-chair fixture authors each caster with swivelAxis {0,1,0} and rollAxis {1,0,0}, demonstrating a non-degenerate intended pair.
Current ObjectGenome tests cover a non-unit mechanism axis and caster persisted-state/decoder semantics, but no equal-axis or antiparallel-axis caster mutation.

Existing proposed leaves HG-BACKFILL-OBJECTGENOME-STRING-BUDGET and HG-BACKFILL-OBJECTGENOME-STATE-BOUNDS cover different memory/work-bound classes; search of ObjectGenome PRs/issues found no existing caster-axis relation repair.
PR #466 records the source-only finding and exact repro; no executable test, Studio, viewport, networking, persistence, or physical-contact evidence is claimed.

metadata.recommendedNext: After the retained ObjectGenome lineage is safely integrated/unblocked, create a bounded source-only caster-axis relation leaf. Reject at least parallel and antiparallel swivel/roll unit-axis pairs in both full inspect and standalone decode preflight; explicitly decide whether v1 additionally requires strict orthogonality or permits tilted/cambered non-collinear axes, then cover canonical/equal/opposite/tolerance boundaries deterministically.
